name: Origin
kid: The main copy of every video, kept in a cloud far away. A video server that doesn’t have a video yet fetches it from here.
nerd: The origin: the master copy in object storage in a cloud region, stored three times over (often in different buildings), so losing a disk or a building loses nothing. Cache misses fill from here, sometimes across an ocean.

1995.kid: Drawn as today. In 1995 there was no main copy far away: the web server had the only copy of the page.
1995.nerd: Drawn as today (an origin in cloud object storage). In 1995 the web server’s own disk held the only copy, with a backup on tape if you were lucky.
